requirement.normalizedRequirement: The engine output P is the maximum output the propulsion machinery can continuously deliver to the propeller(s). If the output is restricted by technical means or regulations, P shall be taken as the restricted output.
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: The engine output P is the total maximum output the propulsion machinery can continuously deliver to the propeller(s). If the output of the machinery is restricted by technical means or by any regulations applicable to the ship, P shall be taken as the restricted output. If additional power sources are available for propulsion power (e.g. shaft motors), in addition to the power of the main engine(s), they shall also be included in the total engine output.
